```{r}
binaryRL.res <- binaryRL::run_m(
  mode = "fit",
  data = binaryRL::Mason_2024_G2,
  id = 1,
  n_params = 3,
  n_trials = 360,
  initial_value = NA_real_,
  threshold = 1,
  pi = 0.1,
  epsilon = NA_real_,
  eta = c(0.3, 0.7),
  tau = c(0.5), 
  priors = list(
    eta = function(x) {stats::dbeta(x, shape1 = 2, shape2 = 2, log = TRUE)}, 
    tau = function(x) {stats::dexp(x, rate = 1, log = TRUE)}
  ),
  policy = "off",
  engine = "cpp"
)

summary(binaryRL.res)

multiRL.model <- multiRL::run_m(
  data = binaryRL::Mason_2024_G2[binaryRL::Mason_2024_G2[, "Subject"] == 1, ],
  behrule = list(
    cue = c("A", "B", "C", "D"),
    rsp = c("A", "B", "C", "D")
  ),
  colnames = list(
    subid = "Subject", block = "Block", trial = "Trial",
    object = c("L_choice", "R_choice"), 
    reward = c("L_reward", "R_reward"),
    action = "Sub_Choose",
    exinfo = c("Frame", "NetWorth", "RT")
  ),
  params = list(
    free = list(
      alphaN = 0.3,
      alphaP = 0.7,
      beta = 0.5
    ),
    fixed = list(
      gamma = 1, 
      delta = 0.1, 
      epsilon = NA_real_,
      zeta = 0
    ),
    constant = list(
      Q0 = NA_real_, 
      lapse = 0.01,
      threshold = 1,
      bonus = 0
    )
  ),
  priors = list(
    alphaN = function(x) {stats::dbeta(x, shape1 = 2, shape2 = 2, log = TRUE)}, 
    alphaP = function(x) {stats::dbeta(x, shape1 = 2, shape2 = 2, log = TRUE)}, 
    beta = function(x) {stats::dexp(x, rate = 1, log = TRUE)}
  ),
  settings = list(
    name = "RSTD",
    mode = "fitting",
    estimate = "MLE",
    policy = "off"
  ),
  engine = "Cpp",
  anythingelse = c(1, 2, 3)
)

multiRL.summary <- multiRL::summary(multiRL.model)
```


```{r}
binaryRL_r <- function(x) {
  binaryRL.res <- binaryRL::run_m(
    mode = "fit",
    data = binaryRL::Mason_2024_G2,
    id = 1,
    n_params = 3,
    n_trials = 360,
    initial_value = 100,
    threshold = 1,
    pi = 0.1,
    epsilon = NA_real_,
    eta = c(0.3, 0.7),
    tau = c(0.5), 
    priors = list(
      eta = function(x) {stats::dbeta(x, shape1 = 2, shape2 = 2, log = TRUE)}, 
      tau = function(x) {stats::dexp(x, rate = 1, log = TRUE)}
    ),
    policy = "on",
    engine = "r"
  )
}
```

```{r}
multiRL_r <- function(x) {
  multiRL.model <- multiRL::run_m(
    data = binaryRL::Mason_2024_G2[binaryRL::Mason_2024_G2[, "Subject"] == 1, ],
    behrule = list(
      cue = c("A", "B", "C", "D"),
      rsp = c("A", "B", "C", "D")
    ),
    colnames = list(
      subid = "Subject", block = "Block", trial = "Trial",
      object = c("L_choice", "R_choice"), 
      reward = c("L_reward", "R_reward"),
      action = "Sub_Choose",
      exinfo = c("Frame", "NetWorth", "RT")
    ),
    params = list(
      free = list(
        alphaN = 0.3,
        alphaP = 0.7,
        beta = 0.5
      ),
      constant = list(
        Q0 = 100, 
        lapse = 0.01,
        bonus = 0
      )
    ),
    priors = list(
      alphaN = function(x) {stats::dbeta(x, shape1 = 2, shape2 = 2, log = TRUE)}, 
      alphaP = function(x) {stats::dbeta(x, shape1 = 2, shape2 = 2, log = TRUE)}, 
      beta = function(x) {stats::dexp(x, rate = 1, log = TRUE)}
    ),
    settings = list(
      name = "RSTD",
      mode = "fitting",
      estimate = "MLE",
      policy = "on",
      system = c("RL", "WM")
    ),
    engine = "R",
    anythingelse = c(1, 2, 3)
  )
}
```
